name: DMDM hydantoin
description: DMDM hydantoin (CAS 6440-58-0 ), also marketed under the trade name Glydant, is a formaldehyde-releasing preservative used to prevent microbial contamination in aqueous formulations. DMDMH delivers broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity against bacteria, yeast, and mold across a wide range of product types. In personal care and cosmetics, it is used to preserve rinse-off and leave-on products. This includes shampoos, conditioners, body washes, and lotions, where water activity creates high microbial risk. Industrial coating and adhesive formulations rely on it as an in-can preservative to extend shelf life. It prevents spoilage during storage and transport for water-based paints, sealants, and latex systems. These systems incorporate DMDMH to protect against bacterial and fungal degradation that would compromise viscosity. It is also used in wet-state preservation of adhesive and elastomer compounds where conventional biocides lack sufficient water compatibility. This ensures long-term stability in complex chemical mixtures. DMDM hydantoin is supplied as a clear aqueous solution, typically at 55% active concentration. It is available in cosmetic-grade and technical-grade specifications to meet the requirements of various applications. Packaging options generally range from drums to intermediate bulk containers (IBCs) for industrial volumes.
